500704.name: Rišňovce
500704.note: The page of the by-election of 6 September 2025 lists only the announcement, voter information and the population count; no okrsky notice.

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: The page of the by-elections of 6 September 2025 links only the ballot paper and the results, no okrsky document; the website's other okrsky documents (2023–2026) give only the polling stations, which cannot place 3 okrsky in 2 parts.

503746.name: Dolné Saliby
503746.note: The municipality's okrsky documents found (2022-11, 2023-06-26, 2024-01-19, 2026-07-30; scans) only create 'Volebný okrsok č. 1' and 'Volebný okrsok č. 2' with one shared polling room (Kultúrny dom 482, later Dolné Saliby 479); none says which addresses or voters belong to which okrsok (the register has no streets, all 887 addresses in one part; the split is evidently by voter list, e.g. alphabetical), so no rules can be written. No document of 2017-2020 found on the website (WordPress search for okrsky/volebná miestnosť); the Internet Archive CDX query did not answer.

510025.name: Rabča
510025.note: The by-election notice (ÚT-vol.miest-čas.doc) gives only the polling stations of okrsky 1-3 (Rabča has one part), no split of addresses. No okrsky document of this vote on rabca.sk (new site's notice board and elections sections searched; old Joomla site's election notices in the Internet Archive hold only voter information, delegation and results). The only okrsky text found is the referendum 2023 article (house-number split), which is another vote's. The Internet Archive answered with frequent HTTP 429.

513156.name: Ilava
513156.note: Found the mayor's Oznámenie o určení volebných miestností pre doplňujúce voľby 6.9.2025 (18.7.2025, https://www.ilava.sk/e_download.php?file=/data/editor/736sk_5.pdf&original=ur%C4%8Denie%20volebnej%20miestnosti.pdf): only okrsok 2 votes, 'ulice: Medňanská, Skala, Jesenského, Kalinčiakova, Hollého, Slnečná a Lašteky I' (ZŠ Medňanská). In 2025 the council obvody were still those of 2022 (six obvody, obvod 2 = okrsok 2 only; Iliavka with Iliavčanská dolina and Záštepy was obvod/okrsok 6), whereas the input's obvody are those of 2026 (obvod 2 including Iliavka). With obvod 2 = okrsky [2] as the Statistical Office counts, okrsok 6 (Iliavka) fits no input obvod, and putting it in obvod 2 is rejected; so no valid rules can be given against these obvody.

518662.name: Očová
518662.note: No document assigning streets to okrsky for this vote: ocova.sk's elections pages (Voľby a referendum: 2018, EP 2019, NRSR 2020, NRSR 2023, local 2025, referendum 2026) and the Internet Archive's captures (2019 elections pages and files) hold only general voter information, e-mail addresses, results and, for 2025 and the referendum 2026, decisions naming the three polling stations without streets; there is no page for the 2017 regional, 2019 presidential or 2024 EP elections.

525634.name: Dobšiná
525634.note: No retrievable okrsky document of this vote. The town's current website (dobsina.sk, Voľby a referendá) holds only the 2026 elections; the Internet Archive's captures of the old vote pages show okrsky notices for the referendum of 2023 (download_file_f.php?id=1761110) and the National Council election of 2023 (id=1878115), but these files are no longer on the site (404) and were not archived; for 2018, 2020, 2024, the by-elections of 2024 and 2025 and the referendum of 2026 no okrsky notice was found.
